title: Chizkiyah, Son of Rav’s Daughter
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sukkah 44b: Chizkiyah and Ivo, the sons of Rav’s daughter, brought a willow before Rav.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied wording בנו ברתיה is read as “sons of his daughter,” supported by the William Davidson digital text of Sukkah 44b, which explicitly writes Ivo and Chizkiyah בני ברתיה דרב. The source’s order of the two names is retained.

The whole Davidson Sukkah 44b paragraph explicitly calls Ivo and Chizkiyah the sons of Rav’s daughter and says they brought the willow before Rav. Hyman’s reverse name order and supplied בנו ברתיה remain unchanged, and the current note remains verbatim. The named kinship direction is not a new authority or genealogy binding.
